package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const LearnerOverviewVersion = "student-learner-overview-v2"

// LearnerOverview is a bounded, provider-neutral projection for the personal
// teacher. It contains current state only and never raw evidence or audit rows.
type LearnerOverview struct {
	StudentID      string                     `json:"student_id"`
	Version        string                     `json:"version"`
	Onboarding     *StudentOnboarding         `json:"onboarding,omitempty"`
	RecentMastery  []StudentTargetMastery     `json:"recent_mastery"`
	LearningPath   *StudentLearningPath       `json:"learning_path,omitempty"`
	Diagnostic     *StudentDiagnosticSnapshot `json:"diagnostic,omitempty"`
	RecentSessions []StudentLearningSession   `json:"recent_sessions"`
}

func NormalizeLearnerOverview(input LearnerOverview) (LearnerOverview, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.Version = strings.TrimSpace(input.Version)
	if input.Version == "" {
		input.Version = LearnerOverviewVersion
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(input.StudentID); err != nil || input.Version != LearnerOverviewVersion || len(input.RecentMastery) > 20 {
		return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview")
	}
	if input.Onboarding != nil {
		profile, err := NormalizeStudentOnboarding(*input.Onboarding)
		if err != nil || profile.StudentID != input.StudentID {
			return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview onboarding")
		}
		input.Onboarding = &profile
	}
	items := make([]StudentTargetMastery, len(input.RecentMastery))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(items))
	for index, item := range input.RecentMastery {
		target, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRef(item.Target)
		identity := targetIdentity(target)
		if err != nil || item.StudentID != input.StudentID || item.PolicyVersion != MasteryPolicyVersion ||
			item.EvidenceCount < 1 || item.IndependentSuccessCount+item.AssistedSuccessCount+item.FailureCount != item.EvidenceCount ||
			item.MasteryScore < 0 || item.MasteryScore > 1 || item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 ||
			item.LastSeenAt.IsZero() || !validLearnerOverviewMasteryState(item.State) {
			return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview mastery")
		}
		if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
			return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("duplicate learner overview mastery")
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		item.Target = target
		item.LastSeenAt = item.LastSeenAt.UTC()
		items[index] = item
	}
	input.RecentMastery = items
	if input.LearningPath != nil {
		path, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(*input.LearningPath)
		if err != nil || path.StudentID != input.StudentID || len(path.Items) > 50 {
			return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview path")
		}
		input.LearningPath = &path
	}
	if input.Diagnostic != nil {
		diagnostic, err := NormalizeStudentDiagnosticSnapshot(*input.Diagnostic)
		if err != nil || diagnostic.StudentID != input.StudentID || len(diagnostic.Items) > 100 {
			return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview diagnostic")
		}
		input.Diagnostic = &diagnostic
	}
	if len(input.RecentSessions) > 5 {
		return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview sessions")
	}
	for index, session := range input.RecentSessions {
		normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningSession(session)
		if err != nil || normalized.StudentID != input.StudentID {
			return LearnerOverview{}, errors.New("invalid learner overview session")
		}
		input.RecentSessions[index] = normalized
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validLearnerOverviewMasteryState(value TargetMasteryState) bool {
	switch value {
	case TargetMasteryExposed, TargetMasteryUnderstood, TargetMasteryPracticed, TargetMasteryApplied, TargetMasteryMastered:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
